about: WIA's notes of 13 and 20 October 2026 as a labelled set the judge (E.B3) is measured against: a diagnostic, never the measure (plan section 3.3 and 4.5: WIA's judgement on live weeks is the measure). Each label is one asset WIA commented on: the text she was shown (the hand-built 13 October packs or the hand-built v2 packs, never system output, R58), her verdict on it (fail or pass), her words, the kind of correction, and her corrected text where she worded one. A label with both texts is a pair the pairwise judge is asked about: it should prefer her version. Process and scope notes (W9 to W13) are kept for completeness and never scored. Week 2 text and these corrections are tests, never prompt exemplars (D28). Client material: research only (R48).
